description: Corn Split Nitrogen Application is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by High Plains Regional Climate Center. This decision support tool can help farmers and farm advisors understand the risks and benefits of using post-planting nitrogen (N) application for corn production. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
